ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark/black) pixels across approximately 95% of the ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to thin linear streaks and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Substrate is a solid dark-pigment field; high-contrast white features consist of thin, unaligned linear filaments distributed across both lobes and high-density white circular clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45-50 degrees, depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; frequency is high with amplitude variations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in depth, creating a jagged silhouette.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve originating from the median notch, sweeping upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black) at the distal tips of both lobes, representing dense barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark substrate, particularly visible on the central-left and central-right regions of the lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) across both lobes and heavy barnacle encrustation on the tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The barnacle clusters at the tips extend beyond the geometric boundary of the skin, creating a high-contrast, irregular terminal edge profile.
